title: Trump's EPA repeals climate pollution limits on fossil fuel power plants
description: The Trump administration is eliminating all limits on climate-warming pollution from the nation's fossil fuel power plants. Fossil fuel interests hailed the proposal, which likely faces legal challenges from environmental groups.

title: Trump's EPA repeals pollution limits on fossil fuel power plants
description: The Trump administration is eliminating limits on climate-warming pollution from the nation's fossil fuel power plants. Environmental groups say this will impact the climate and public health.
